title: top-up: Apple container egress containment
definition: Per-launch internal network for Apple `container`, with the allowlist proxy sidecar attached to both the internal and the external network so the worker's outbound traffic is meant to go through it (partial containment: the host gateway, DNS and LAN are outside what it promises); a version-verified CLI capability check that refuses a runtime whose flags cannot be proven; per-control egress probe results where a probe that did not run is recorded as not-run and never as a pass; a scoped stale-resource sweep that removes only networks named exactly `vibe-egress-<pid>` whose launcher pid is dead, together with that pid's proxy container `vibe-coder-egress-proxy-<pid>`, and leaves live, own-pid and non-matching names alone; and bounded recovery that refuses the launch rather than falling back to unrestricted networking.
